levels.description: Small, slight goblin filling half the frame height, in patched clothing with one simple salvage tool; tentative upright posture, no armor, no weapon upgrades, no power effects.
levels.title: Cinder Scavenger

levels.description: Noticeably taller and sturdier, two thirds of the frame height; gains copper bracers and one sealed fantasy bomb, a confident square stance and only a faint spark effect.
levels.title: Copper Spark

levels.description: Large and broad, four fifths of the frame height; layered copper and leather armor, a signature oversized sealed bomb and bomb belt, planted posture, visible curling amber magical sparks.
levels.title: Cinder Bombardier

levels.description: Towering and heroic, nearly full frame height with safe margins; ornate complete copper armor, abundant sealed bomb equipment and a legendary-scale magical bomb, commanding posture and strong amber ember effects.
levels.title: Emberstorm Paragon

prompt: A goblin with a bomb affinity
theme: Soot-charcoal, olive green, rust red, muted ochre, weathered copper and leather; rounded fantasy bomb silhouettes, spark motifs and soot smudges. Soft watercolor on paper.
